snippet.title: Hearsay | Trailer | Sort cut-up songs by ear
snippet.description:
Every recording in a basement archive has been cut into unlabeled tapes. Listen, find the right genre cabinet, and shelve the pieces in the order you hear them. A full row checks itself: green is right, yellow is the right song in the wrong place, red doesn't belong.

164 recordings, ten genres, no timer, no fail state. Free demo on Steam now. Out November 3.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5274720/Hearsay/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=launch&utm_content=trailer_v5

Music: "Pixelland", "Summon the Rawk", "Jazz Brunch", "Hush", "Ice Demon", "8bit Dungeon Level", "River Valley Breakdown" and "Got Funk" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
